messages.subject: Senior International Executive | Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs | GCC Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Leinders,

I am reaching out for consideration for confidential senior leadership mandates across the Middle East and wider international markets.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and high-stakes stakeholder relationships within a major natural-resources operation.

My strongest fit is where business strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution across corporate, technical, community and public-sector stakeholders. I am open to Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates, including expatriate appointments across the GCC and other international markets.

Your leadership of Korn Ferry's MENA executive-search and industrial practice, including energy, infrastructure and complex-market appointments, makes this a focused introduction.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for current or future mandates aligned with Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership, and Energy or Resources leadership.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
